description: React component for editing and saving a datasource (dataset) in Apache Superset, including UI elements, state management, and API interactions.

classes.name: DatasourceModal
classes.description: React functional component for editing a dataset's configuration, handling save/cancel actions, and rendering the modal UI.

methods.name: buildExtraJsonObject
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with certification and warning markdown info for dataset metrics or columns.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload object for saving the dataset, including metrics, columns, and other metadata.

methods.name: onConfirmSave
methods.description: Performs the API call to save the dataset and handles success/error responses.

methods.name: onDatasourceChange
methods.description: Updates the current datasource state when changes are made in the editor.

methods.name: getSaveDialog
methods.description: Returns the JSX for the save confirmation dialog with warnings and options.

methods.name: onClickSave
methods.description: Triggers the display of the save confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleConfirmSave
methods.description: Executes the save operation after user confirms.
